Q: NextJS SSR in Capacitor A:

No, it isn't possible with Capacitor. You need a backend that runs your Next.js server and your will connect to it. The server can't be bundled into the Capacitor app.

Q: SQL Server Bulk import data from .csv into new table A:

I am currently struggling with the same problem. I have first read the first row (headers) using bulk insert and created the table. Then again using bulk insert from row 2 imported data in the table. Although you have to change datatype after checking the data imported.

CREATE TABLE #Header(HeadString nvarchar(max))

declare @TableName nvarchar(100)='byom.DenormReportingData_100_100'
DECLARE @Columns nvarchar(max)=''
declare @Query nvarchar(max)=''
DECLARE @QUERY2 NVARCHAR(MAX)=''
bulk insert #Header
from 'F:/Data/BDL_BI_Test.csv'
with(firstrow=1,lastrow=1)

select @Columns=(select quotename(value)+' VARCHAR(500)'+',' from #Header cross apply string_split(HeadString,',') for xml path(''))
if isnull(@Columns,'')<>''
begin
set @Columns = left(@Columns,len(@Columns)-1)

select @Query=@Query+'CREATE TABLE '+@TableName+' ('+@Columns+')'
exec(@QUERY)
end

select @QUERY2 =@QUERY2+'bulk insert '+@TableName+' from ''F:/Data/BDL_BI_Test.csv'' 
with(firstrow=2,FORMAT=''csv'',FIELDTERMINATOR='','',ROWTERMINATOR=''\n'')'
exec(@QUERY2)

Q: Epson thermal printer JavaScript A:

With your edit mentioning a CORS issue, perhaps you can try running Chrome with web-security disabled. That should tell chrome to ignore the failing CORS header:

chromium-browser --disable-web-security

https://www.chromium.org/developers/how-tos/run-chromium-with-flags

Q: Wild cards in autosys A:

If you are specifc about looking for particular file name, based on date:

You can use a enviornment variable defined in the profile file. This variable can be updated with today's date as in the example given below. Because the profile is sourced on each run of the job, the variable will be available to the autosys job.

In unix based enviornment, add following to profile file:

export TODAYS_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d`

In the autosys file watcher job, use the variable as follows:

watch_file: /v/global/user/s/sr/sritamd/BESTEX/imsbestex_${TODAYS_DATE}

Q: Count print pages on a worksheet A: 
Sub ShowMe()
    x = ExecuteExcel4Macro("GET.DOCUMENT(50)")
    MsgBox x & " pages will be printed."
    
    y = (ActiveSheet.HPageBreaks.Count + 1) * (ActiveSheet.VPageBreaks.Count + 1)
    MsgBox y & " pages will be printed."
End Sub

' for empty sheet x = 0, y = 1;  Ctrl+P return no pages found

Q: Replace all spaces in a string with + A:

Use strings.ReplaceAll

tw.Text = strings.ReplaceAll(tw.Text, " ", "+")

If you're using an older version of go (< 1.12), use strings.Replace with -1 as limit (infinite)

tw.Text = strings.Replace(tw.Text, " ", "+", -1)

Q: My copy of "Processing" does not have the "processing.serial" library A:

Reinstalling Processing will solve your problem. But if you don't want to reinstall, download the zip file for your architecture (e.g., processing-4.5.1-macos-x64-portable.zip) from the release page. Serial will be in directory Processing/app/resources/modes/java/libraries/serial. Copy that to your own installation.
